description: low voltage base topologies is a data resource listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data under the section "Distribution network datasets > Basisnetztopologien MONA 2030", published or maintained by ffe.de (publisher inferred from the link). In the project MONA 2030 several low voltage base topologies were published (CC BY 4.0). Coverage: as stated on the linked page. The openmod wiki page "Distribution network datasets" lists it under "Basisnetztopologien MONA 2030". It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the wiki page (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity distribution network inputs to energy-system models. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
